hu.fiok.reg_cel: Hozd létre a fiókod. Utána megadod, milyen hírek érdekelnek.
hu.fiok.jelszo_sugo: Legalább 10 karakter. Több szót is használhatsz.
hu.fiok.reg_adatkezeles: A fiók létrehozásával elfogadod, hogyan kezeljük az adataidat:
hu.fiok.visszaallitas_szoveg: A jelszót a rendszergazda állítja vissza. Írj neki:
hu.hiba.rossz_paros: Az e-mail-cím vagy a jelszó nem megfelelő. Próbáld újra.
hu.onboarding.kesz_szoveg: Következő lépés: add meg, mely hírportálokat figyeljük, és mely témák érdekelnek.
hu.onboarding.kesz_arculat: Az arculatot (logó, színek) később, a Szervezet adatai lapon adhatod meg.
hu.onboarding1.bevezeto: Elég a weboldal címe vagy néhány mondat. Ebből készítünk egy javaslatot, amit átírhatsz.
hu.onboarding1.vagy: Ha nincs weboldal, írd le pár mondatban.
hu.onboarding1.mivel_sugo: Például: pékségünk van Marosvásárhelyen, helyi családoknak sütünk.
hu.onboarding2.halasztas: Amit most nem tudsz, később is kitöltheted.
hu.onboarding2.javaslat_keszul: Készítjük a javaslatokat… A mezőket közben is szerkesztheted.
hu.onboarding2.javaslat_kesz: Elkészültek a javaslatok. Írd át, ahol nem stimmel.
hu.onboarding2.javaslat_hiba: A javaslat most nem készült el. Kitöltheted kézzel is.
hu.onboarding3.bevezeto: Nézd át a javaslatot, és javítsd, ha szükséges.
hu.onboarding3.arculat_kesobb: Az arculatot később, a Szervezet adatai lapon állíthatod be.

ro.fiok.reg_cel: Creează-ți contul. Apoi ne spui ce fel de știri te interesează.
ro.fiok.jelszo_sugo: Cel puțin 10 caractere. Poți folosi și mai multe cuvinte.
ro.fiok.reg_adatkezeles: Creând contul accepți modul în care prelucrăm datele tale:
ro.fiok.visszaallitas_szoveg: Parola este resetată de administrator. Scrie-i:
ro.hiba.jelszo_rovid: Introdu o parolă de cel puțin 10 caractere.
ro.hiba.rossz_paros: Adresa de e-mail sau parola nu este corectă. Încearcă din nou.
ro.onboarding.kesz_cim: Gata — datele organizației au fost salvate.
ro.onboarding.kesz_szoveg: Pasul următor: spune-ne ce portaluri de știri să urmărim și ce teme te interesează.
ro.onboarding.kesz_arculat: Identitatea vizuală (logo, culori) o poți adăuga mai târziu, pe pagina Datele organizației.
ro.onboarding1.bevezeto: Este suficientă adresa site-ului sau câteva propoziții. Din acestea pregătim o propunere, pe care o poți rescrie.
ro.onboarding1.vagy: Dacă nu aveți site, descrie în câteva propoziții.
ro.onboarding1.mivel_sugo: De exemplu: avem o brutărie în Târgu Mureș, coacem pentru familiile din zonă.
ro.onboarding2.halasztas: Ce nu știi acum, poți completa mai târziu.
ro.onboarding2.javaslat_keszul: Pregătim propunerile… Poți edita câmpurile în acest timp.
ro.onboarding2.javaslat_kesz: Propunerile sunt gata. Rescrie ce nu se potrivește.
ro.onboarding2.javaslat_hiba: Propunerea nu a putut fi pregătită acum. Poți completa și manual.
ro.onboarding3.bevezeto: Verifică propunerea și corectează dacă este nevoie.
ro.onboarding3.arculat_kesobb: Identitatea vizuală o poți seta mai târziu, pe pagina Datele organizației.

en.fiok.reg_cel: Create your account. Next you tell us what news interests you.
en.fiok.jelszo_sugo: At least 10 characters. You can use several words.
en.fiok.reg_adatkezeles: By creating an account you accept how we handle your data:
en.fiok.visszaallitas_szoveg: Your password is reset by the administrator. Write to them:
en.hiba.jelszo_rovid: Enter a password of at least 10 characters.
en.hiba.rossz_paros: The email address or password is not correct. Try again.
en.onboarding.kesz_cim: Done — your organisation's details are saved.
en.onboarding.kesz_szoveg: Next step: tell us which news sites to watch and which topics interest you.
en.onboarding.kesz_arculat: You can add your visual identity (logo, colours) later, on the Organisation details page.
en.onboarding1.bevezeto: A website address or a few sentences is enough. We prepare a draft from it that you can rewrite.
en.onboarding1.vagy: If you have no website, describe it in a few sentences.
en.onboarding1.mivel_sugo: For example: we run a bakery in Târgu Mureș, baking for local families.
en.onboarding2.cim: Who do we write for, and how?
en.onboarding2.halasztas: Anything you don't know now you can fill in later.
en.onboarding2.cel: What do you want to achieve?
en.onboarding2.nyelvek: What language should we write in?
en.onboarding2.stilus: What style should we write in?
en.onboarding2.javaslat_keszul: Preparing the drafts… You can keep editing the fields.
en.onboarding2.javaslat_kesz: The drafts are ready. Rewrite anything that doesn't fit.
en.onboarding2.javaslat_hiba: The draft could not be prepared now. You can also fill it in by hand.
en.onboarding3.bevezeto: Review the draft and correct it if needed.
en.onboarding3.arculat_kesobb: You can set your visual identity later, on the Organisation details page.
